pages.text: $(thing)Constructions$()$(br2)With only a compass and a straightedge: bisect an angle, draw a perpendicular, divide a line in the golden ratio. Unlocks Golden Ratio Glass on the Geometer's Table.

$(thing)Insight$(): 60$(br2)$(thing)Builds on$(): Euclid's Elements.$(br2)$(thing)Samples$(): 1 Euclidean Shard.$(br2)$(thing)Derivation$(): A right triangle has legs a and b. Write the length D of its long side.
